Take a look at Motion. I've used it for some very basic functionality and it's been great. I know it's got tons of features built in, but it might be a bit confusing to configure.

Motion

I know you said you tried it, but ZoneMinder really is the go-to option in the Linux world. Camera setup is by far the most annoying part; once you get past that, it's a breeze, and you never have to deal with the configs again. The main thing you'll usually run into with the setup is directory permissions -- at least, that's been my experience.

As far as Xeoma goes, call me paranoid all you want, but I wouldn't trust anything coming out of Russia these days, especially when the download site itself says "ignore virus warnings" on the binaries.
